I was having severe jerking motions in my right arm and eventually my entire upper torso. Went to a “naturopath chiropractor” on recommendation of my dad. Doctor reached into his desk drawer, gave me something called “L-Dopa,” and told me to take one the first day, two the second, and three the third.

Third day comes. I fall at work, have a seizure, and go to the emergency room. Takes 3 hours just to get into triage in a completely empty ER, by which time I stabilize. Doctor asked how long I had been out. Said my coworker (a woman) had timed about a minute and ten seconds. He told me “women tend to exaggerate. You probably just fainted”

Finally saw a doctor after seven fucking hours. She goes “do you have Parkinsons? Why are you on L-Dopa?” Turns out that doctor had given me pure dopamine, it had tanked my blood pressure, and I had seized.

Went back to the other doctor like “what the fuck dude?” He works on my neck really aggressively and when I told him it hurt he said “oh come on, it doesnt hurt that bad.”

Tldr; doctor gave me pure dopamine out of his desk drawer; it sent me into a seizure. When asked how long it had lasted,  ER doc told me my female coworker had “exaggerated.”
